_comment: Why the V6.2.12 sign-up probe may call its password breached. `password` is BREACHED in crates/sv-check/src/signed_in.rs, and a test there fails if the two differ, so the password cannot be changed without new evidence. `sha1` is the password's SHA-1 (`printf '%s' 1qaz2wsx3edc4rfv | sha1sum`); Pwned Passwords is asked for the range of its first five characters and answers with every suffix in that range and how often each was seen, so the password itself was never sent. The line below is the one in that range whose suffix is the rest of `sha1`. It was fetched by the owner in a browser and pasted into the session, because this environment's network policy refused the request from here; docs/BACKLOG.md has the item to re-check it with a script. Data: Have I Been Pwned, Pwned Passwords, https://haveibeenpwned.com/Passwords, licensed CC BY 4.0.
